mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits catecholamine metabolism while nifedipine causes vasodilation, creating risk of hypertensive crisis and excessive hypotension with sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and ensure adequate washout period (14 days) after MAOI discontinuation before starting nifedipine.
